observed: Garellek2013 pp88–89 operationally coded full glottal stop in an English corpus using silence lasting at least two local pulse periods plus release/return to voicing; incomplete/creak categories and conservative ambiguity were retained. This is not a universal threshold or ancient Hebrew validation.
Official Praat methods specify seconds/Hz, window bandwidth and speaker-sensitive formant settings; existing McAulay-Quatieri analysis requires a measured waveform.
